Name: (CP)Alfonse - Custom NPC from Fire Emblem Heroes
Author: DzBao
Description:
[center][size=3]*Alfonse is a character from the mobile game Fire Emblem Heroes by IntSys/Nintendo. While it is recommended that you check out the game, you don't have to know anything about FEH to enjoy this mod.*
[/size][/center][center][size=3]﻿
[/size]﻿[/center][center][size=3]This is a [b]non-profit[/b] fanwork, all characters and their franchise belongs to their respective owners.[/size]
[size=1](TLDR; Nintendo plz don't sue me :( )[/size][/center]
[size=3][center]Compatible with [b]SVE[/b], [b]RSV[/b], any mod that doesn't change the [b]Bus stop[/b] map[/center][/size]

[u][size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]:[/u] [size=3]Alfonse is a datable NPC that lives at the Bus Stop, his story revolves around the Community Center :3 The mod comes with seasonal outfits, heart events (10 and 14 heart events not yet included), i18n translation supported and sprinkled flavor texts about Fire Emblem[/size]

[center][u][size=5]NOTE:[/size][/u]
[size=4]THE CHARACTER IS MALE, BUT SINCE I PUT A LOT OF EFFORT INTO HIS FLOWER DANCE SPRITE, I HAD TO MAKE HIM FEMALE. WILL LOOK FOR A WAY TO CHANGE PRONOUNS.[/size]
[size=4]PLEASE INFORM ME IF YOU'RE MAKING A TRANSLATION FOR THIS MOD. AND PLEASE DON'T USE AI :([/size][size=4]
[/size][/center]
[size=5][b][u]Gift taste:[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3][b]Loved: [/b]Books, Blue jazz, sunflower, smoked fish, tea, fairy rose, goat cheese, blobfish, tuna, stonefish, goby, sea urchin, rainbow shell, sweetpea, etc.
[b]Liked:[/b] coffee, garlic, daffodil, dried fruits
[b]Neutral:[/b] dried mushroom, rabbit foot, pickle, mayonnaise
[b]Dislikes: [/b]green bean, pizza, carp surprise
[b]Hate[/b]: sap, sea cucumber, moss soup
[/size]... and more!

interactable cookie table whoo 👀

[b][u][size=5]Story idea[/size][/u][/b][size=3]: [/size][size=5]HUGE[/size][size=3] spoilers alert. please don't read this if you want to discover things yourself[/size]
[size=3][spoiler] Alfonse's story in this mod is tied heavily to the Community Center, which means if you finish the Joja route, he would just poof out of existence.
The mod comes with one craftable, a basket, when given he'll fetch in-season forage for you; giving him bait (the normal one) for base-xp below 20 fish. Do note that these count as gifts! [/spoiler]

Added 9 new mail quests with custom letter backgrounds, 1 trinket and 4 recipes
Fixed some lines of dialogue, made mails repeatable
Rebalance Marth emblem ring[/size]

[size=5][b][u]Known limitations:[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]I mostly tested this in my huge mods folder (270+ with both RSV and SVE), so there could be a chance that the character appears in some location inaccessible in the vanilla version. Do let me know if you find one!
HEADCANONS!!!
English isn't my first language, so some lines may come out as awkward, especially in the heart events x( will improve
No ginger island for now
Flat head sprite :(
[/size]

PRIOR TO 15/12/2025[/size][size=4], if you have this mod already installed, please DELETE it and redownload
When I started modding, I used the Yumii NPC mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyommers/mods]nyommers[/url]﻿ to learn how to make my own NPC. And with that, I accidentally used their redrawn Neighbor Cabin for my mod, mistaking it for the OG version. I have reached out to them, and I've made another version of the cabin based on the Log Cabin in the game (even though the file's name is still Neighbor Cabin). So if you have the version posted before 15/12/2025, please have it deleted.
Once again, I'm very sorry, I should have known better and check it beforehand[/size]
[/left]
